description: This file provides a set of shell functions to manage services through start-stop-daemon, including operations such as start, stop, check if running, reload, and signal sending. It also defines environment variables to customize service behavior.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to control services with different actions (-C, -S, -K) and passing executable and arguments.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if the service executable is running.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to the service process, defaulting to USR1.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the service, attempting graceful shutdown, then forcefully if needed.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads the service using the reload signal.
